notes: Optics-judge golden calibration set (masterplan H1B2). Ground truth is UNAMBIGUOUS by construction: the good goldens are the own-eyes-verified production capture (plus a mild exposure lift of it), the bad goldens are one real capture-law-clause-2 lie plus synthetic degradations of the good capture through the two production wash regression classes (make_synthetic_goldens.py regenerates them). If calibration breaks, fix the judge (prompt/models/quorum), never the goldens.

excluded_borderline.RigMatExperiment_E0_CTRL.png: 2026-07-02: measured global value/saturation stats nearly identical to the reference cover (mean_v 0.485 vs 0.489, dark_frac 0.205 vs 0.178) - its washout is micro-scale seam contrast only, and judges flip on it run to run. A borderline case destabilizes binary calibration under EITHER label; kept in artifacts/zythan_mat_experiment as experiment evidence.
excluded_borderline.RigMatExperiment_E1_EM0.png: 2026-07-02: pixel-identical to good_rig_ship_production after downscale (deterministic tick-less renderer) - added no information as a separate golden.

goldens.name: good_rig_ship_production

goldens.name: good_exposure_lift

goldens.name: bad_lowmip_washed
